subject: [hw] DONE DEC06: Slim.videodecoder avc1/hvc1 object; N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2124/2124; arm64-ios16 dylib+import audit
body:
DONE DEC06. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit outside my owned files.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2124/2124
Same run prints:
  T_NAL PASS 138/138/141/141/117 x2 builds  (avc-high, avc-full, hevc-main, hevc-full, hevc-main10; ffmpeg also decodes every converted Annex B stream: same frame count and size)
  T_PIXELS PASS 83 x2        (MM21 detile/crop/padded strides vs an independent forward tiler, NV12, I420, refusals)
  T_CLIENT PASS 76 x2        (rev-2 decoder messages vs an in-memory daemon over the frozen transport)
  T_OBJ PASS 147 x2 + 147 TSan (registration/switches, class record, StartSession, DecodeFrame, display-order reorder, FLUSH drain/drop, CanAccept, base copyProperty, invalidate, failures, 2 sessions/2 threads)
  DEC06 DEC05 adapter: client (client/dec/n2vcd_dec.c) and my adapter compile against DEC05 staged rev-2 header; every n2vcd_* call resolves
  DEC06 ios imports: 63 undefined, all covered (59 TBD, 4 weak/linker); 6/6 objects arm64-apple-ios16.0; dylib links, exports _SLIMRegister
~40 s, /tmp/n2hw-DEC06 46 MB, vt/dec 460 KB, no file over 300 KB.

What is implemented (vt/dec/**):
- n2vtd_obj.c: CMBaseObject of VTVideoDecoderGetClassID() via CMDerivedObjectCreate; class record version 2 with StartSession, DecodeFrame, CopySupportedPropertyDictionary, SetProperties, CopySerializableProperties, CanAcceptFormatDescription (exact param-set compare), FinishDelayedFrames; tile slots NULL. StartSession = atoms/n2_apple parse -> DEC_HEADER -> pool -> VTDecoderSessionSetPixelBufferAttributes (420f iff SPS VUI video_full_range). DecodeFrame = sample -> Annex B -> DEC_INPUT -> DEC_PICTURE* -> MM21 detile into VTDecoderSessionCreatePixelBuffer -> emit each token exactly once in the daemon display order with its pts; FinishDelayedFrames = FLUSH + drain + FrameDropped for leftovers; idempotent invalidate/finalize; base copyProperty answers UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder/IsHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder = true.
- n2vtd_nal.{h,c}: avcC/hvcC records, SPS (H.264+H.265 incl. short-term RPS/scaling lists so VUI full-range is reachable), conformance window, params equality, length-prefix -> Annex B with passthrough detection. Values checked against ffprobe (5 ffmpeg streams incl. 320x180 cropped and 10-bit).
- n2vtd_pixels.{h,c}: MM21 16x32/16x16 detile, NV12, I420, crop, padded destination strides; plane sizes match the vendor 1080p numbers (Y 2088960 + C 1044480).
- n2vtd_client.h + n2vtd_client_dec05.c (adapter over client/dec/n2vcd_dec.h; live once the rev-2 header lands) + n2vtd_client_proto.c (stand-in over the frozen transport, rev-2 wire format incl. 32-byte ADD_BUFFER/OPEN flags/poc).
- n2vtd_register.c: VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo(avc1, hvc1), CMClassImplementationID, IsHardwareAccelerated=true, Rating 100; switches nord2-video-hwdec (required), nord2-video-off (veto), -no-hevc; CreateInstance does a 250 ms cached HELLO and returns -12913 so VT tries H264SW/VCPHEVC. SLIMRegister is visibility(default) and is exported in the linked dylib.
- symbols.txt (import list + images), STATUS.md with the full honest list, test/ (mkvectors.py, decoder-side host Apple runtime t_apple_dec.{h,c}, scripted client t_fakeclient_dec.{h,c}, t_nal/t_pixels/t_client/t_obj).

NOT done (full text in vt/dec/STATUS.md and dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md):
- No phone run and no daemon end-to-end. The DEC05 adapter is compile/link-checked only; the object ran against the scripted client. First on-phone frame unproven.
- MM21 tile ORDER is [I] (plane sizes pin the tiling, not the order). Widths whose stride is not a multiple of 32, and heights not a multiple of 32, are refused (copies_failed), not guessed.
- Crop origin is always 0: DEC05 has no field and its AP adapter refuses nonzero vsi.crop.left/top.
- 10-bit / non-4:2:0 / interlaced: StartSession succeeds (VT does not retry it) and DecodeFrame returns -12910; no nested software VTDecompressionSession fallback.
- In-band parameter-set changes are passed to the daemon but our geometry/attributes are not updated mid-stream.
- CPU-side pixel copy (no NEON/Metal/zero-copy). setProperties/copySerializableProperties reply -12782 (documented "use base class"); copySupportedPropertyDictionary is empty.
- Emit is called while the object session mutex is held (watch on the phone).

Wrote in my Owned dir only: gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/{n2vtd_vt.h,n2vtd_obj.c,n2vtd_nal.h,n2vtd_nal.c,n2vtd_pixels.h,n2vtd_pixels.c,n2vtd_apple.h,n2vtd_client.h,n2vtd_client_proto.c,n2vtd_client_dec05.c,n2vtd_register.c,symbols.txt,STATUS.md,run_tests.sh,test/{mkvectors.py,t_apple_dec.h,t_apple_dec.c,t_fakeclient_dec.h,t_fakeclient_dec.c,t_support.h,t_support.c,t_nal.c,t_pixels.c,t_client.c,t_obj.c}} and gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md.

Staying available for R1/R2/lead findings; the DEC05 and header questions are posted separately.
